description_en: Updates a data quality rule template in a project
description_zh: 用于更新指定项目下的数据质量规则模板配置
name: UpdateDataQualityTemplate

parameters.help_en: The ID of the custom rule template
parameters.name: id

parameters.help_en: Detailed configuration Spec code of the rule template. For more information, see [Data quality Spec configuration description](~2963394~)
parameters.help_zh: 规则模板详细配置 Spec 代码，详情请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2963394.html
parameters.name: spec

parameters.help_en: The account ID of the owner
parameters.name: owner

RequestId.description_en: The API request ID, which is generated as a UUID

Success.description_en: Indicates whether the rule template is updated successfully
Success.description_zh: 规则模板是否更新成功
